Theorem
[Short-time heat-kernel expansion] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0253, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0254 ↗ thm:chow-iii-ch23-parametrix-heat-kernel ↗ lem:chow-iii-ch23-convolution-estimates 1. ch23:23.17\group Asymptotics

There are smooth $u_j$ on $\mathcal M\times \mathcal M$, with $u_0(y,y)=1$, such that \[ H(x,y,t)\sim (4\pi t)^{-n/2}e^{-d(x,y)^2/4t}\sum _{j=0}^{\infty }t^ju_j(x,y). \] More precisely, after truncation at $N$, the remainder is $O(t^{N+1-n/2})$ uniformly in $x,y$.
Proof

\sketch Take $u_j=\eta (d)\phi _j$ for $j\le N$ and subtract the finite parametrix from the representation of $H$. The convolution estimate in Lemma 2 bounds the difference by $C\int _0^t(t-s)^{N-n/2}\, ds=O(t^{N+1-n/2})$.

□
